cd /workspace && cat > tools/bench_cut.py <<'PY'
import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import Job, find_deficient_cut

def bench(n, m, k, Dval, p=1, seed=1):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    used=set(); links=[]
    while len(links)<m:
        u=rng.randrange(n); v=rng.randrange(n)
        if u==v: continue
        kk=(min(u,v),max(u,v))
        if kk in used: continue
        used.add(kk); links.append((u,v,rng.randint(1,100)))
    ps=rng.sample(range(n), k)
    demands={v: Dval for v in ps}
    env={l: rng.randint(1,60) for l in range(m)}
    job=Job(n,links,demands,p,env)
    t0=time.monotonic(); cut=find_deficient_cut(job); dt=time.monotonic()-t0
    print(f'n={n} m={m} |C|={k}: cut={"yes" if cut else "no"} time={dt:.3f}s')

bench(48, 128, 32, 10**6)
bench(48, 128, 32, 1)
bench(48, 47, 32, 10**6)
bench(32, 32, 32, 1)
bench(16, 40, 8, 10)
bench(48, 128, 16, 10**9)
PY
timeout 600 python3 -B tools/bench_cut.py
